summary: Does pm.bsd.assignment.v1 gain a state member for an assignment paused by the user or by the quarantine safety pause? (Printed words ruled by the lead pass.)
detail: Pause advisor dispatches cmd.bsd.assignment.pause (BSD-033), but canon has no context_state for a user pause, and pm.bsd.assignment.v1's state list has no paused member either (only paused_quota). The design printed "Unavailable · paused by you" pending E-10; DL-110 settled the three words on the card and did not decide this. Options: map a user pause to unavailable with the plain fact "paused by you", or add a paused member to the assignment state and a context_state of its own with a plain word. BSD-035 leaves it unsettled. Widened after blind review finding R-09 (cycle 1): a second consecutive quarantine (pm.bsd.quarantine.v1 terminal_action pause_bsd, §11) also pauses the assignment, and neither the pm.bsd.assignment.v1 state list nor context_state covers it, yet BSD-033 resumes it through cmd.bsd.assignment.resume, which §17 defines for a paused assignment. The design's provisional table printed it as Failed with the plain fact "paused for safety: its last two answers weren't usable" (DESIGN-SPEC 8.6, IMPACT A1-27). BSD-035 and the owner-answers preface now name both pauses as unsettled. Lead pass (dec-013, DESIGN-SPEC §8.6 IMPACT A1-27): the printed words and context_state are ruled and compiled into BSD-035 (user pause: context_state unavailable, "Unavailable · paused by you"; quarantine pause: context_state failed, "Failed · paused for safety: its last two answers weren't usable"; neither adds a context_state). Still open: whether the assignment record's state list gains a paused member, which the spec does not state; needs the owner or the record-shape owner.

summary: What finding state and presentation_weight does a stale terminal critical carry when it is shown, and can it be dismissed?
detail: §8's terminal catch-up timeout shows an unreconfirmed critical without reconfirmation, so it never passes the emitted transition of rule 4. §16 leaves presentation_weight absent until emission, and BSD-037 accepts cmd.bsd.finding.dismiss only for an emitted finding, yet BSD-032 says a stale note that is later dismissed renders as a dismissed line and BSD-030 puts the dismissal control on every full note. Options: the shown stale critical moves to emitted with stale and unreconfirmed kept in data and note weight stamped when shown, and dismissal accepts it; or it stays held while shown, renders at note weight by severity, and dismissal rejects it with already_in_state (BSD-032's dismissed-line sentence then goes). Blind review finding R-07 (should_fix), not repaired in cycle 1 because the choice is a state-machine decision the sources do not make. Lead pass: the spec narrows but does not settle this. DESIGN-SPEC §4.3 C21 gives pmxNote data-state emitted|stale|dismissed with the actions "Why? · Dismiss" on every note, and §8.6 says a dismissed note "never relabels itself stale", so a shown stale note is dismissable and the second option's already_in_state rejection is ruled out. The finding state it carries while shown and its presentation_weight are not stated by the spec. Needs the owner (state-machine choice).
